scenarios.name: baseline
scenarios.description: No scenario overlays: inferred transmission parameters and default hub itinerary mixing (Track B).
scenarios.technical_explanation: parameter_overrides is empty. network_modifications is empty so apply_modifications leaves ContactNetwork unchanged: itinerary_patch_weight and itinerary_flight_weight stay 1.0 from build_world_contact_network. Ensemble draws p_transmit, contacts_daily, incubation, h2h_multiplier, and cfr from the inferred posterior summaries (or raw posterior samples when provided), then runs the ABM with patch co-location exposure (contacts_daily enters as mix = contacts_daily / 24 on patch pressure).

scenarios.name: terminal_distancing
scenarios.similar_to: Social distancing in airports and crowded travel settings.
scenarios.description: Weaker effective mixing when people share the same airport patch (same movement paths as baseline).
scenarios.technical_explanation: network_modifications.modify_weights.itinerary_patch scales ContactNetwork.itinerary_patch_weight in apply_modifications (multiplier below 1). The ABM uses pw = itinerary_patch_weight when agents are grouped by patch (default world has itinerary_contact_patch; flight groups are zero). p_transmit and contacts_daily are unchanged from inference. Same Markov itinerary as baseline.

scenarios.name: reduced_travel_connectivity
scenarios.similar_to: Lighter travel and fewer effective connections.
scenarios.description: Lower effective daily contact intensity while keeping the same hub cohort and itinerary matrix.
scenarios.technical_explanation: parameter_overrides.contacts_daily sets a lower mean for the Monte Carlo draws (ensemble._draw_parameter_samples uses scenario_params; posterior resampling gets mean alignment via _align_drawn_means). In abm.simulate_trajectory, contacts_daily scales exposure through mix = contacts_daily / 24 applied to patch pressure. itinerary_patch_weight unchanged unless you add itinerary_patch in JSON.

scenarios.name: enhanced_case_isolation
scenarios.similar_to: Stricter isolation when cases are identified.
scenarios.description: Lower per-contact transmission given the same mixing (faster finding and separation of infectious individuals).
scenarios.technical_explanation: parameter_overrides.p_transmit_scale multiplies baseline p_transmit in ScenarioSpec.apply_to_parameters before sampling. Ensemble uses the adjusted mean for truncated normals or aligns posterior draws to scenario_params.p_transmit. Network weights unchanged.
